label: AUDUSD cross-asset London opening-range continuation into New York (Monday shorts) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `SI London opening-range continuation into New York (Monday shorts)`. London first-half-hour continuation into New York. Filter: short signals on weekday 0. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection.
verificationSummary: Cross-asset strict PF 2.20 over 95 trades; average planned RR 4.99, min planned RR 4.29; bootstrap p05 1.48, block-bootstrap p05 1.39, annual pass rate 80%.
